# Unit and Membership Renewal

Scouting America provides an online process for member and unit renewals.
Below are several resources to help ensure a smooth and efficient renewal
experience. All units and members currently registered with Scouting America
must complete this process annually.

## Orientation Video: Unit and Membership Renewal

### Member and Unit Renewal Process

Unit renewal and member renewal are no longer be one and the same. Membership
is now a set 12 month term from the time of registering regardless of when the
unit renews. Youth and adult leader membership are separated from the unit
renewal.

Unit Renewal Steps

Login

At My.Scouting.org and go to Organization Manager (Unit Leader, Committee
Chair, Chartered Organization Representative, or COR designee have access).

1

Click On “Unit Renewal” on the menu

2

Validate Information

3

Review Information

Make any necessary changes.

4

Enter your name in the signature field

5

Pay and Submit

6

The annual charter agreement is mandatory and must be obtained outside of the
electronic process. After completing the updated charter agreement, please
file it in the unit’s records at the council office.

Individual Renewal Steps

Login

At My.Scouting.org

1

Select the Notice Icon

Found in the top right corner

2

Select pop up option

“Registration for John Doe is expiring soon, click here to renew.”

3

Review Information

Select “Go To Payment”

4

Agree to the Terms & Conditions

5

Confirm / Edit Scout Life subscription

6

Enter / Confirm Credit Card info

7

Select "Place Order"

8

Select "Complete Registration"

9

## Frequently Asked Questions

If you don’t see your question here, check out the full list of FAQs here.

[ Unit Leader FAQ
](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/resources/2024-Renewal/Unit-Leader-
New-Unit-and-Annual-Membership-Renewal-Process-FAQ-6.12.2024.pdf)

[ Master FAQ
](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/resources/2024-Renewal/Master-
Renewal-Process-Q%26A-Organized-by-Topic-December-2024.pdf)

[ June 2024 Webinar Q&A
](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/resources/2024-Renewal/Membership-
Renewal-Process-Webiner_QA_6.18.24.pdf)

[ October 2024 Webinar Q&A
](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/resources/2024-Renewal/FAQ-Renewal-
Process-Webinar-Oct-2024.pdf)

When can a unit begin the renewal process?

Unit Renewal begins two months before the unit expiration date, and then we
have a two month lapsed period to allow for late renewal.

Who Can Submit the Unit Renewal?

The Unit Key 3 can renew the unit and renew members if needed.

Does the COR delegate have access as well?

Yes, they will.

Is there a Unit Renewal Status Report?

Yes, reports through the Council Dashboard in My.Scouting are available
showing the stages of the submittal processes of a unit.

Can the online payment option be turned off?

No, the ability for a unit to pay online cannot be turned off.

Is a unit required to pay their renewal fee online?

No, there is an option for ACH, Credit Card or pay at the council.

Can a unit designate which families they will be paying for while others are
family pay?

Yes. The unit can designate who they are paying for.

Can the council print the Charter Renewal Agreement?

The council can print out a screen shot of the Org manager page for the unit
to sign if needed, and soon a report will be customized for this.

How can the COR sign

The COR can login to Organization Manager and sign the form and then process
the renewal, or any of the Unit Key-3 can sign.

How can we avoid delays

The new process is much simpler but the two things you can do before you go to
renew the unit charter is to check in Roster and see if all your adult leaders
are current with YPT, and then check to see if you have any “aged out” youth,
Scouts BSA that are now 18 years old as an example.

What is the process for unit switching charter organizations to proceed with
unit renewal?

Units must submit the new unit paperwork found at
<https://www.scouting.org/commissioners/starting-sustaining-and-growing-
units/start-a-new-unit/> and the letter of release from the old chartering
organization to the council and it must be approved prior to starting unit
renewal.

How do you (council or unit) remove aged out youth who won't return?

They will move to the “Members without Unit” report and will drop off as they
naturally expire. Neither the council nor the unit has the ability to “remove”
them.

Will charter agreement forms still be needed?

Yes

Who at the council level is responsible for setting the Auto Approval Renewals
selections?

The Scout Executive or a Council K-3 delegate has access to Organization
Manager and can make this selection.
